lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Nicaragua to estimate populations in acute food insecurity under different scenarios. The resulting population estimates represent direct impacts of food security crises, primarily driven by drought and economic shocks affecting agricultural livelihoods.
